text:
lina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on pipeline / GTM / partners. Drop clarifying Qs here and we'll assign owners.

raj: Top concern from sales leadership: pipeline health in EMEA. We saw a 20% quarter-over-quarter dip in forecasted late-stage deals in EMEA. Need root-cause (seasonality vs coverage).

nina: Do we have rep coverage map for EMEA? If it's coverage, we should consider temporary SDR support + localized enablement.

oliver: Coverage map is on the shared drive. Early look shows gaps in DACH and Nordics. Proposal: 2-week SDR blitz + 1 localized demo hire per region for Q2.

sasha: For partners: the co-marketing fund ask came up. Leadership asked for a simple approval flow and KPIs. Can we limit to partners with >3 qualified opps in last 6 months?

raj: That sounds reasonable. Also want guardrails: 1) co-marketing spend capped by ARR band, 2) require partner-sourced leads to be tagged in CRM at creation.

mike: On product side, RL demo sandboxes for partners will be available as a self-serve image next week. Should accelerate partner demos and reduce manual setup.

nina: Two quick ops asks: 1) can we add `partner_source` and `partner_credit_pct` fields to the CRM? 2) create a saved report for pipeline influenced by partners.

oliver: I'll own the CRM fields. Proposed field names: `partner_source`, `partner_involved` (boolean), `partner_credit_pct`. Example mapping: partner-led -> 100, partner-assisted -> 30.

sasha: Agree. Also request: a short email template for partners when we hand off leads to reps. Want standardized expectations.

lina: Owner notes: oliver to add CRM fields (owner: oliver, due: Tue), sasha to draft partner-hand-off email (owner: sasha, due: Wed), raj to convene EMEA pipeline huddle (owner: raj, due: Fri).

raj: One more ask from sales: can product commit to a minor API route for partner token scoping so partners can demo without access to prod keys? Needs investment ~2 engineer-weeks.

mike: We can deliver scoped token route as a lightweight feature flag. I'll confirm capacity; ETA mid-Q2 if approved.

nina: On incentives: leadership asked us to pilot a small uplift for partners that bring ARR > $250k ACV deals. Suggest $5k marketing credit + SDR bonus for qualification. Thoughts?

oliver: Let's gate that by requiring partners to register opportunities in the portal within 48hrs of contact, otherwise credit not eligible.

sasha: Also recommend a weekly sync during the pilot to catch playbook friction.

lina: Good call. Action: sasha to schedule weekly pilot syncs (owner: sasha, due: Mon), and oliver to add portal registration SLA to partner T&C (owner: oliver, due: Thu).

ci-bot: Recording + transcript: https://redwood-internal.example.com/recordings/1840539999 (recording uploaded).

lina: Thanks all. If you need me to escalate any blockers to execs, ping here. Short checklist for next steps would be helpful in this thread. :rocket:
